brief: @buildthis.bisks.net on goodsky, feeds other than discover don't load when unauthed. if the user is unauthed, can we just not show feeds other than discover, and if unauthed offer to optionally log the user in by surfacing the modal that's already there?
note: Turns out custom feeds just don't work without a session (Bluesky's public API bounces them). Logged-out visitors on goodsky now only see Discover, and every other feed link offers to log you in instead of showing a broken feed.
